purpose: Source-backed reference facts for affiliate program planning. This file is informational metadata, not a runtime commission table, payout promise, tax opinion, or approval guarantee.
interpretationRules: A published base rate applies only to the stated country, channel, product class, attribution condition, and effective period.
An advertised maximum or promotional rate is not a guaranteed standard commission. Record the live rate shown in the applicable partner dashboard or insertion order before estimating revenue.
Programs run by the same company may be separate by country, platform, publisher tier, creator channel, advertiser approval, or campaign.
No commission or payment rate in this reference should be embedded as a product price, guaranteed earning, or durable runtime constant.
Tax handling and eligibility depend on the participant, country, and current program terms. This reference does not give tax or legal advice.

programs.market: US marketplace (other Amazon country programs require separate locale review)

rateFacts.qualifiedCondition: Actual product classification controls; this is not a simple rule that all beauty, fashion, or electronics items share one rate. A current special promotion may add or replace rates.

eligibility.associates_review: The official review guide requires at least three qualifying sales within the first 180 days after signup; personal orders do not qualify. This is the Associates application-review gate.
eligibility.creators_api: Separate gate: enrolled and accepted Associates account, at least 10 qualifying sales in the trailing 30 days, API registration and credentials. The 10-sales/30-day condition is API access, not the same as the Associates 3-sales/180-day review condition.

enrollmentAndPayment.paymentOptions: Amazon lists direct deposit, gift certificate and check for domestic users; international options include direct deposit where available, gift certificate and check. The US portal lists USD 10 minimum for direct deposit/gift certificate and USD 100 for check.
enrollmentAndPayment.internationalBanking: The Fx4Cash page describes bank transfer for specified Associates programs and supported USD, GBP or EUR bank-account countries; this is not universal across countries. South Korea is not in the listed 52-country set on that page.
enrollmentAndPayment.payoneerClaim: The official US portal does not state that Payoneer is universally required. Payment methods and country availability must be checked in the target marketplace account.

rateFacts.surface: Rakuten Ichiba standard qualifying product categories
rateFacts.qualifiedCondition: Category controls; most standard products have a per-item JPY 1,000 commission cap and JPY 3,000 monthly per-user cap. Track click must lead to cart within 24 hours and completed purchase within 89 days.

rateFacts.rateType: published rate-up range for eligible partners and selected shop/category products, not the standard rate
rateFacts.qualifiedCondition: Eligibility can vary by partner and month. Rates and participating shops update daily; eligible products are shown in the affiliate product search. Rate-up products are exempt from the cited standard payout caps.

enrollmentAndPayment.payout: Standard compensation is paid in Rakuten Points/Rakuten Cash under the applicable program rules. The Japan guide says full bank transfer is available only after at least JPY 3,001 qualifying commission in each of three consecutive months and review; higher cash payment conditions also require the applicable Rakuten ID/card or linked Rakuten Bank setup.
enrollmentAndPayment.note: This is Rakuten Japan, not Rakuten Advertising's international affiliate network. Do not conflate points, Rakuten Cash and bank-transfer conditions.

crossProgramClaimChecks.claim: Domestic programs automatically pay KRW after universal 3.3% withholding.
crossProgramClaimChecks.finding: The Olive Young domestic guide uses participant approval and own-name bank details, and requires an electronic tax invoice from individual business operators. It does not establish that every participant or domestic affiliate program has a universal 3.3% withholding rule.

crossProgramClaimChecks.claim: Foreign affiliate payouts universally require a foreign-currency account or Payoneer.
crossProgramClaimChecks.finding: Official methods differ: Olive Young Global lists PayPal; Amazon lists direct deposit where supported, gift certificate and check; AliExpress Portals describes remittance to a designated bank account; Rakuten Japan pays program-specific points/cash and offers conditional bank transfer. Country and account eligibility must be checked per program.

crossProgramClaimChecks.claim: Affiliate program rates can be summarized once as one rate per company.
crossProgramClaimChecks.finding: The verified programs vary rates or enrollment by market, category, product, channel, creator tier, campaign, network approval, and current dashboard terms. Keep verified public facts descriptive and resolve the live offer for the exact participant/account before revenue estimates.
